digest.component_or_area: tickets store initialization and CI checkout
propositions: Full clone of tickets costs 1.04 GiB / 59s wall time; partial clone with blob:none filter reduces to 68.7 MiB / 14.3s (15x reduction)
P1 bug: tickets fetch timeout causes silent bootstrap of empty orphan branch via worktree add --orphan, diverging from origin/tickets and returning empty reads
Blob:none partial clone preserves complete commit graph for merge-base and ancestry scoping required by verify_authorship, making it safe for CI verification
Current verify-identity job in gerrit-verify.yaml fetches full history (6.73m of 7.3m job time) despite blob:none being compatible with commit ancestry requirements
Fail-open fallthrough to orphan bootstrap must be replaced with fail-closed exit to prevent silent empty-store divergence
Six child tasks scope the remediation: merge driver config, checkout filter application, fail-closed behavior, blame error handling, commit resolver robustness, and bridge-state cleanup
